$comment: Contract -> landed test mapping for operator-controlled capability composition (ADR 0130). Seeded 2026-09-22 from the checkout on branch claude/new-session-9wpwbh by reading the test files and, where 'observed' says so, by running them. A row is 'covered' only when a named test exists for it; 'pending' means no landed test names the contract and 'owner' says which area owes it. No result here is asserted that was not either read from source or produced by a run recorded in 'runs'.

status.covered: at least one landed test names the contract id
status.pending: no landed test names the contract id

observed.run-passed: the test file was executed in this session and every test in it passed
observed.run-failed: the test file was executed in this session and at least one test in it failed
observed.read-only: the test exists in the checkout and was read, but was not executed in this session

runs.command: cd packages/capability-composition && pnpm exec vitest run

runs.note: The one failure is src/lib/capabilities/classification.test.ts > 'matches every source module the build sees', reporting src/modules/ports-b.ts, src/modules/tutorial-pick-b.ts and src/modules/tutorial-test-realm.ts as unclassified. Those three files were written by concurrent module-owner work minutes before the run and have no SOURCE_CLASSIFICATION rule yet. The count includes src/lib/capabilities.test.ts (17 tests), which is the pre-existing connector-capability suite and is unrelated to composition.

runs.command: pnpm --filter @opensesame/pages exec vitest run src/lib/runtime-config.test.ts src/App.test.tsx
